70010000125877.description: Take on dangerous solo contracts across distant planets in this first-person survival horror experience. Explore abandoned bases, search dark corridors, and collect valuable scrap to meet your assigned quota. Each planet features different locations, hazards, and hostile creatures. Manage your limited inventory, avoid deadly traps, and decide when it is time to escape with your haul. Staying too long may cost you everything. Every expedition is a separate challenge. If you die, all collected scrap is lost and the mission begins again. Explore carefully, complete the quota, and survive the horrors waiting inside.
70010000125877.intro: A solo survival horror experience where every contract could be your last.
70010000125877.name: Lethal Corporation

70010000080243.description:
Toy Tactics is a physics-based real time tactics game where you can draw unit formations and command units based on minifigs to victory. Under the guidance of legendary generals, master the ability to draw configurations into the battlefield and send miniature legions to war against hordes of undead foes. Charge up your army with artifacts and destructive spells to give you the upper hand in battle and smash your foes in real-time. Think fast, deploy your units strategically, and lead them to victory!

Units inspired on minifigs
All units in Toy Tactics are inspired by miniature figures used to recreate historical battles and fictional ones too! Fight against, or as, skeletal dinosaurs, spooky necromancers, and stealthy samurai. These bloodthirsty enemies want you to utter destruction. Battles occur in many scenarios, from the sunny pirate-dominated island of Tortuga in the Caribbean to the perilous mountains of feudal Japan; expect the unexpected!

Draw unique and personalized formations
Freeze the game at any time to draw new formations. From simple commands to charge and encircle your enemies to more complex strategic formations like pincer or wedge formations, divide your army into battalions and give each one a unique formation. The battlefield is a canvas, and you are its artist.

Real Time Physics for Real Time Strategy!
Just as in a real battle, in Toy Tactics your minifigs helmets are sure to roll. Watch your units fight with fully simulated physics for every encounter, crumble castle walls, and destroy structures. Witness the chaos and destruction unfold in a most epic fashion as the field is flooded with combat scenes.

Unlock Powerful Spells
Turn a bad situation around with our spell and relic system. Defeat enemies to charge up your power, then summon reinforcement catapults, quickly construct medical tents to heal allies or drop flaming meteors onto the heads of your foes. Personalize your strategies by unlocking your favorite spells through our skill tree; the possibilities are endless!

Features:
A physics-based RTS game with a unique drawing system.

- Many unit types with strengths and weaknesses: raptor mounting skeletons, stealthy samurai warriors, impenetrable Roman legions, and many more!
- Magical spells to blow enemies away, heal your allies, bring back fallen enemies as allies, and more!
- Physics simulation system that sends foes flying and helmets rolling.
- Five challenging campaigns, each with its challenging boss fights!

Toy Tactics offers a hardcore strategy experience that will challenge even the most seasoned commanders! Gear up, draw your formations, and lead your minifig troops to victory. See you on the battlefield, commander!
70010000080243.intro: Command minifig-inspired armies and customize strategies with hand-drawn formations. Conquer unique campaigns for all five armies and unleash massive battles.
70010000080243.name: Toy Tactics

70010000104669.description:
• COMING OF AGE IN THE AFTERLIFE 

Grim Trials is a heavy metal action roguelite where you craft and customize your own weapons and equipment to embrace Death your own way. Play as Avelin, a young woman who has met an untimely end, and found herself recruited as one of Death’s many Reapers. Tasked to hunt down impure souls, face her demons, and fight her way through an underworld of her own making, Avelin must endure these trials to become a full-fledged Reaper and see her still-living love once again. 

• REAP THEIR SOULS 

Endless hex-grid arenas filled with monsters, traps, sinful souls, and 7 sacrilegious bosses await. Slay them all with a variety of customizable scythes, crossbows, and powerful Blessings from the Gods of Death around the world. Master the scythe and crossbow to maximize damage to your foes with a unique combat system that rewards clever use of your dual-wielded weapons. 

• GATHER MATERIALS & CRAFT EQUIPMENT

The spoils of battle are the tools of your trade. Gather materials from the battlefield and work with your mentors in the arcane arts to craft new and ever more powerful weapons, armor, and consumables. 

• CUSTOMIZE GEARS & CREATE PERSONALIZED BUILD 

Every reaper carves their own path! Mix and match your crafted equipment with skills gained from investing in an expansive skill tree at the start of every run, then choose carefully from the randomized Blessings you obtain mid-run to create powerful builds! 

• A NEW LIFE AFTER DEATH Explore 

The Academy, built for the training and arming of Death’s various Reapers. Seek enlightenment from mentors, take on quests to build your relationships, and unlock sage advice, knowledge, and powerful support from your peers. Learn the stories of the dead by interacting with the Academy’s denizens. 

• LOVE CONQUERS DEATH 

Coming of age in the afterlife was certainly not the plan, but dying means little to the already-dead, and love unyielding wields power no god can rival. Every time Avelin falls in battle, the experience and materials you’ve earned stay with her. Live, fight, die, then live again, over and over until the promise is kept.
70010000104669.intro: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials.
70010000104669.name: Grim Trials

70010000122460.description:
Challenge yourself in Driving Is Hard! Drive a bathtub on wheels through steep, unforgiving terrain where every mistake costs you progress. Master tough physics-based gameplay, sharpen your patience, and uncover Jeff’s journey of self-doubt, family struggles, and emotional growth as he finds strength, self-acceptance, and hope for a brighter future.


FEATURES

• Drive a Bathtub: Navigate Jeff in a physics-based bathtub on wheels

• Select Your Difficulty: Driving is Easy for a relaxing time with checkpoints, Driving is Hard - the original challenge, Driving is Insane for insane people.

• Explore 7 Worlds: Each with unique challenges and mechanics.

• Easy to Play, Hard to Master: Simple controls, challenging mechanics.

• Emotional Journey: Jeff faces his father’s expectations and finds his own path.

• Customizable Bathtub: Unlock and use different car skins.

• Collect Soaps: Find 21 soaps as you play.


WARNING!
This difficult game tests your patience - falling is part of the challenge. Will you rise or quit when it gets tough?
70010000122460.intro: Prove your skills by driving the Bathtub on Wheels! Solve puzzles, collect soap, and dive into Jeff's family drama. Drive, Fall, Learn, Repeat.
70010000122460.name: Driving is Hard

70010000123856.description: A juicy first-person incremental game about growing berries and tossing them down an ominous hole. Earn money and upgrades. Make new friends with sentient berry pals. Grow and control the hole as you unearth why nobody leaves this accursed garden. Bury it all, Berry everything.
70010000123856.name: Berry Bury Berry

70010000124041.description:
Since then, countless moons have passed...
As people wove generations together, she quietly continued to fulfill her duty.

But at last, the time came, and the silence was broken.
Old and weary, she gathered her last strength
and spread her wings to find out the hero...

- About Dungeon Antiqua 2
Dungeon Antiqua 2 is a 2D dungeon hack-and-slash RPG featuring SNES-style pixel art and sound.
A retro-flavored adventure awaits you, blending strategic exploration with a highly flexible character building system.

- Exploration
Players will explore six dungeons, navigating with a unique system where visibility of corridors and enemies depends on the character’s “vision".
Dungeon Antiqua 2 uses a symbol encounter system—you can avoid battles by dodging enemies, or strike first and take the initiative. The path forward is yours to carve through skill and decision-making!

- System
In addition to the eight jobs from the previous game, two new classes—Monk and Archer—have been added, bringing the total to ten.
Earn skill points from victorious battles; once they reach the required threshold, you’ll unlock job-specific skills.
Since changing jobs does not reset level, you can freely experiment with multiple jobs to create your own ultimate party!
note: Five jobs are available at the start of the game. The remaining five types will become available as you progress through the game.

- Concept
Sometimes, why not take a step back and return to the cartridge era of gaming?
By stripping away excessive story cutscenes and focusing on short, simple dialogue and text, the world is designed to spark your imagination—inviting you to create your own personal adventure.

- Playtime
For a first playthrough, we estimate a playtime of approximately 10-12 hours.

Dungeon Antiqua
This game takes place hundreds of years after the story of Dungeon Antiqua.
You may even come across some familiar characters from the previous game…
70010000124041.intro: A retro 2D dungeon crawler bursting with 16-bit nostalgia.
70010000124041.name: Dungeon Antiqua 2

70010000126797.description:
Become a cheerful delivery bird and explore a colourful archipelago filled with charming villages, friendly locals and plenty of deliveries to complete.

Fly freely between the islands, collect letters, parcels and special cargo from pick-up points, then deliver them safely to the correct destination. Each successful delivery rewards you with coins that can be used to upgrade your equipment and unlock new possibilities.

Customise your delivery cart with stronger wheels that allow you to carry heavier loads. You can also equip special badges that provide useful bonuses, including higher delivery rewards, extra coins and faster progression.

Master dynamic delivery challenges by flying through boost rings to build speed, optimise your routes and complete each job as quickly as possible.

Discover new islands, meet memorable residents, grow your delivery service and become the greatest winged courier in the entire archipelago.

Features

• Explore a colourful world made up of beautiful islands.
• Deliver letters, parcels and valuable cargo.
• Upgrade your delivery cart with stronger wheels for heavier loads.
• Equip special badges with unique gameplay bonuses.
• Fly through boost rings to complete deliveries faster.
• Earn coins, unlock upgrades and expand your delivery service.
• Relaxing gameplay with a charming cartoon-inspired visual style.
• Easy to learn and satisfying to master.
70010000126797.intro: Take to the skies, deliver with care and connect the residents of a peaceful island community, one parcel at a time.
70010000126797.name: Aerialia: Wings of Delivery

70010000127486.description:
Prepare for a prehistoric battle where intelligence matters more than brute force. In Dino Hex Trap, every trap can completely change the course of the invasion, and every decision transforms the battlefield into a massive strategic puzzle filled with action and creativity.

Forget fixed towers and predictable strategies. Here, you control traps placed across a dynamic hexagonal field where direction, spacing, and positioning make all the difference. Rotate, reposition, and combine traps to turn seemingly safe routes into true corridors of Jurassic destruction.

Waves of dinosaur-inspired creatures keep advancing, and it is up to you to stop them before they reach your base. But resources are limited, so every choice matters: expand your defence with new traps or reorganise the ones you already have? Improvisation is part of survival.

As the campaign progresses, new trap types unlock increasingly creative possibilities. Some levels already begin with fixed structures spread throughout the map, completely changing the way you think about strategy and forcing you to constantly adapt.

With 30 levels spread across morning, afternoon, and night biomes, Dino Hex Trap combines planning, resource management, and spatial awareness in fast, smart, and deeply satisfying challenges.

With stylish visuals, engaging battles, and that perfect feeling of “now my strategy is brilliant,” Dino Hex Trap is an irresistible experience for players who love strategic defence, meaningful decisions, and defeating hordes in the most creative ways possible.

Watch the paths, prepare your traps, and prove that even dinosaurs can fall into the perfect plan.
70010000127486.name: Dino Hex Trap

70010000128547.description:
Take the controls of real JR-West trains in this authentic railway driving game, officially licensed by West Japan Railway Company (JR-West).

■ The exhilaration of the Special Rapid Service

Drive the famous Special Rapid Service non-stop from the very first station of the Keishin Line all the way to the terminus. On quadruple-track sections, blast past local trains one after another for a rush of speed only this train can deliver. Direct Rapid and local services are fully drivable too.

■ Every line, every section, both directions

Three fictional lines inspired by the region — the Ohan East Line, Ohan West Line, and Keishin Line — with every section drivable in both directions. A massive amount of track that rewards every hour you put in.

■ Drivable trains

Drive the 221, 223, 207, and 321 Series, plus the 227 Series appearing as a special test-run train.

■ A series first: the driving score system

Your accuracy behind the controls — departing on time, passing stations on schedule, keeping to speed limits, stopping precisely at the mark — is rated as a score, so you can feel yourself improving with every run.

■ Boost your score with your card deck

Set cards in your deck before each run. Meet the scoring conditions to earn bonus points based on each card's multiplier.

The cards feature a spectacular lineup of 14 train series, including limited express trains: the 223, 221, 321, 207, 227, 287, 283, 289, 281, 271, 683, 225, 115, and 485 Series.

Match cards of the same type to double their values with Chemistry, collect cards of the same station for a station score bonus, and upgrade your cards to build the ultimate deck. New cards are obtained through an in-game gacha — there are no paid purchases.

Struggling with the controls? A clever deck can still carry you to victory. A master driver with a weak deck will find high scores out of reach. Driving skill and deck strategy: two ways to play, one deep experience.

■ Mascon controller support

Compatible with the ZUIKI MasCon for Nintendo Switch™ and the Densha de GO!! One Handle Controller for Nintendo Switch™ (電車でGO!!専用ワンハンドルコントローラー for Nintendo Switch™) for an even more realistic driver experience.

■ Recommended for

- Train and railway fans

- Anyone who loves Japan's Kansai region

- Deck-building and card game enthusiasts

- Owners of a mascon-style train controller

In-game languages: Japanese, English
70010000128547.intro: Drive real JR-West trains! An authentic, officially licensed railway driving game.
70010000128547.name: Train Plus Japan Drive Western Japan Trains! Rapid Service Edition

70010000130509.description:
Reckon the case looks clean at first glance?

Take another look. One precise spot in the picture may be waiting for a sharp detective mind.

Perfect Crime Case Files is a laid-back picture puzzle game where you inspect each case image and choose the single correct area.

How to play:
・Check the illustration closely
・Find the spot that matches the question
・Use the cursor or tap the area to answer

No fiddly rules, no fuss. Just observe the scene, think it through, and back your instincts.

Spot it quickly or take your time with a second look; every case brings a neat little moment of discovery.

Great for a quick puzzle break or a chilled mystery session whenever you feel like one.

Button controls and touch controls are supported, so you can play whichever way feels right.
70010000130509.name: Perfect Crime Case Files

70010000130528.description:
How much of the picture will still be there once it’s covered?

You had 60 seconds to take it all in. Easy as, right? Until the question asks about the one detail you nearly missed.

The Final Scene is a visual memory quiz with a quick, tense rhythm: study an illustration, watch part of it get masked, then answer from four choices using only your memory.

・Study the image for 60 seconds
・Once it is masked, read the question
・Pick one answer from four options
・Answer correctly to bring back the original image

Simple to play, but every hidden detail makes you second-guess what you saw. Great for a quick brain workout, a relaxed challenge, or a few rounds with mates.

Look closely, trust your memory, and see whether the final picture reveals the truth.

Button and touch controls are both supported.
70010000130528.intro: Reckon you’ll remember the final detail?
70010000130528.name: The Final Scene

70010000130728.description:
Ascent DX is a tiny metroidvania brought to life in glorious 64 x 64 pixel art and soothing chiptune music. Crashed on an unknown planet you have to explore lush jungles, lifeless deserts, and luminescent caves in search of anything that can help you understand what has happened to the planet and how to get off it.

While the game is a bigger version of the original Ascent, with almost twice as many locations to explore, it is still quite a short game. With the same celebrated gameplay and atmosphere, the DX version also brings more items to find, more platforming puzzles, and more lore to uncover. 

Features:
* A world brought to life by tiny but expressive pixel art
* Explore the planet's many biomes in your own pace and direction
* Find new powers and abilities that help you on your way
* Uncover the fate of the planet as well as your own 
* Different endings based on how much was discovered

Credits:
Design, code, & pixel art: Johan Peitz
Music & sfx: Brent Houston
Capsule art: Jon Nielsen 
Nintendo Switch™ port: Corey Underdown
70010000130728.intro: Crashed on a desolate but mysterious planet you find yourself eye to eye with an ancient civilisation. Explore the planet, find powerful upgrades and fulfil your destiny.
70010000130728.name: Ascent DX

70010000130861.description:
YOUR WORLD, BUT TWISTED  
When your best friend vanishes, you must enter the Dark Reflection—a hostile, warped copy of your own reality. Here, familiar places are dangerous, and friendly faces cannot be trusted.

SURVIVE THE NIGHTMARE  
The Dark Reflection is a classic side-scrolling pixel-art adventure packed with action, puzzles, and heavy metal energy.

Explore: Search creepy locations and find vital items to survive.

Solve: Use your brain and your inventory to clear obstacles.

Fight: Slash your way through hordes of demons and unique bosses.

DARK HUMOUR & HEAVY METAL  
Step into a world where dark humour meets a heavy rock soundtrack. Every corner hides a secret, and every choice matters.

Features

Warped World: Explore an unsettling, distorted reality.

Classic Gameplay: Solve puzzles and manage items to progress.

Brutal Battles: Fight aggressive monsters and giant bosses.

Hidden Secrets: Find secret paths and weird encounters.

Your Choice: Make decisions that lead to multiple endings.

Turn up the volume of your doom.
70010000130861.intro: A thrash metal album reveals a ritual that opens a portal to another world.
70010000130861.name: Dark Reflection

70010000131309.description:
Wobbly Life is a vibrant open-world physics sandbox. Play with your friends online or in local co-op, with exciting jobs, mini games and wacky story missions. Earn cash to spend in the world on clothes, vehicles and houses. There is a whole Wobbly World out there to explore!

Grandma has kicked you out into the big wide Wobbly world demanding you go and GET A JOB! She would be so proud if you could earn some money and get your own house one day! 

It's time to start earning and living your best Wobbly Life! 

Includes Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition features:
- GameShare: Play Wobbly Life with anyone – even if they don't own the game! 
- GameChat: Share audio and video while playing with your friends. 
- Start where you left off on Nintendo Switch™ with forwards compatible save game to Nintendo Switch™ 2
- 1-4 players online and local split screen co-op

Open-world sandbox filled with mini-games, toys, secrets and SO MUCH more 

+100 unique missions & jobs with exclusive rewards to unlock, alone or with friends 

+90 vehicles to ride around (and crash)

+500 clothes items to show-off in your wobbly look 

+infinite number of wobbly fun! 
 
FUN, FRIENDS & PHYSICS!

Let's start exploring! Almost everything is interactive – grab, play, and experiment in a world filled with props, mini-games, and surprises.  

Experience the joy of individual quests and shared adventures with up to 4 players in online or local co-op, all in one fantastical world. 

MYSTERIES AND MISSIONS

Embark on story missions, each offering unique rewards through satisfying puzzles and challenges. Unveil the mysteries of the tropical island, uncover the mountain’s secrets, delve into hidden caves...  

The Wobbly Museum has lost all its artifacts! Maybe you can help? Buy treasure maps and solve clues to find all the Museums' lost treasures and unlock fun rewards. 

GO GET A JOB!

Make grandma happy and go get that job! Earn money by choosing from +20 exciting jobs, each bringing their new unique challenges. From pizza delivery to firefighting, taxi driver to disco dancer… your wobbly dream job is waiting for you. 

LIVE THE HIGH WOBBLY LIFE! 

Once you’ve fattened up your bank account why not go on a shopping spree? Visit the Pet Shop to buy a faithful companion, buy and unlock +500 clothes items and choose from +90 different vehicles.  

When you’ve really made the big bucks, you can even buy a house: from a wooden shack to a huge fancy mansion, Wobbly Island has a home for everyone whatever your taste! 

PLAY YOUR OWN WAY WITH ARCADE MODE

Want to take a break from the Wobbly Island? Try out the Arcade mode! Discover four new game modes: Trash Zone, Hide & Seek, Wobble Run and Sandbox. Each have customizable settings for you to play with, multiple mini-games and new areas to have fun in!

GO TO SPACE! The Wobbly Space Programme is looking for new recruits. Space is a whole new open world, with new jobs, missions, and secrets to uncover. You'll even get to fly your own spaceships too, so what are you waiting for!
70010000131309.name: Wobbly Life - Nintendo Switch™  2 Edition

70010000132078.description:
Settle in with two ukiyo-e pictures inspired by the well-known road from Edo to Kyoto.

This easygoing observation puzzle is all about noticing the small thing that has changed. Travellers, belongings, buildings and scenery may all pull your attention, so take your time and pick the right spot.

How to play:
・Compare the two ukiyo-e pictures
・Find the place that has changed
・Select the area you think is correct

Enjoy the artwork, the landscapes and the travellers while giving your focus a gentle workout. Great for a quick breather, or for looking over each picture at your own pace.

Recommended if you like:
・Spot-the-difference games and visual puzzles
・Ukiyo-e and Japanese scenery
・Relaxed brain-training challenges
・Talking through the answer with family or mates

Check every corner of the artwork and uncover the hidden difference!

Both button controls and touch controls are supported.
70010000132078.name: Spot the Difference Ukiyo-e: Fifty-Three Stations of the Tōkaidō

70010000132199.description:
What would you clear from the scene so the truth never gets out?

This is a mystery puzzle game where you collect the evidence left behind and try to turn each case into something no one can solve.

You are not the detective. You are an evidence cleaner, brought in by the culprit to scrub away the traces they left at the scene.
Read the brief, look over the illustration, and spot the evidence that has to go.

How to play:
・Read the case brief
・Inspect the illustrated scene
・Choose the matching piece of evidence

Pick the right one, and that item disappears from the scene.
Keep an eye out for footprints, belongings, objects and odd little details, then remove the clues that could land your client in trouble.

The requests and the stories behind them all vary.
Each scene asks you to work out what needs to be erased, putting your observation and deduction skills to the test.
With one-question chunks, it is easy to play in short bursts while still getting a proper puzzle fix.

Great for players who enjoy mysteries, deduction, illustration spotting and clever brain teasers.
Gather every piece of evidence and send the case cold.

Button and touch controls are supported.
70010000132199.intro:
Can you find every clue?
Pick it, wipe it clean
A shady mystery puzzle
70010000132199.name: Vanishing Evidence: Mystery Cases

70010000132228.description:
Make world flags and country names easy to practise with a relaxed, game-style learning experience.

No fiddly controls here. Read the country name or question, have a good look at the four flag images, then choose the one that matches.

How to play:
・Check the question on the screen
・Compare the four flag images
・Pick the flag you reckon is correct

From familiar flags to designs with similar colours and shapes, every go helps you connect countries and flags a little more clearly.

It is great for quick sessions, whether you are testing your own knowledge or chatting through the answer with kids and family.

Recommended if you:
・Are curious about flags from around the world
・Want a fun way to brush up on countries and geography
・Need a simple learning game for children
・Prefer easy, fuss-free controls
・Like learning in small bursts during downtime

How many flags can you tell apart?
Think of countries across the globe and aim for a perfect run!

Playable with buttons or touch controls.
70010000132228.name: Slot & Learn WORLD FLAGS

70010000132551.description:
How well can you read a scene when the night makes everything feel a bit off?

You know the moment: the picture seems ordinary, but your eyes keep circling back to something suspicious.

Midnight Anomaly Mystery is an easy-going picture quiz where you study one illustration and pick the single area that answers the question.

How to play:
・Check the image closely
・Find the area that fits the prompt
・Select that spot to answer

No fuss, no lengthy rules. Each round stands on its own, so it is great for a quick break or a longer run of visual challenges.

Play with button controls or touch controls. Take a good look and see whether you can pin down the strange detail.
70010000132551.name: Midnight Anomaly Mystery

70010000132975.description:
Keen for a puzzle that feels great when the route finally lines up?

This intuitive rotation puzzle has you turning jumbled panels until the broken path becomes one continuous line again.

Study the picture, check which way each line is facing, and figure out the best direction for every panel. It starts nice and simple, then gradually asks for more focus and a sharper bit of insight.

How to play:

・Pick the panel you want to turn
・Rotate it to change its direction
・Finish the route to clear the stage

Early stages begin with a small layout. As you move on, there are more panels to handle and the connections become trickier to read.

Great for a quick breather, or for a relaxed solo session when you feel like taking your time.

Use your observation skills and intuition to connect the path from start to finish!

Button controls and touch controls are both supported.
70010000132975.intro:
Can you join the whole track?
Spin panels, sharpen your mind!
70010000132975.name: Road Line Puzzle: Connect the Paths

70050000072139.description:
Expand your garage with the RACE - ExTerminator Pack!

ExTerminator is a powerful Gunner-class combat car built for explosive arena racing. Designed for relentless rocket attacks, it keeps the pressure on rivals and turns every battle into a barrage of destruction.

Its ultimate ability, Judgment Day, increases rocket attack power when activated and can be used up to 3 times per race.

This DLC includes:
- ExTerminator car
- 6 vinyls
- 6 flags
- 4 avatars

Vinyls and flags can be used on any unlocked car.
70050000072139.intro: Unlock the ExTerminator car and exclusive customisation items.
70050000072139.name: RACE - ExTerminator Pack

70010000118193.description:
You awake in a mysterious casino where evil poker emojis have awakened — and they’re not happy to see you.

This rogue-like first-person shooter throws you into a wild casino environments, fast-paced combat against gambling addicted emojis wearing funny hats and wielding powers.

Before each run, customize your experience with crazy modifiers: make enemies bounce, wear funny hats, or unleash maximum casino power for maximum challenge. 

Armed with just a pistol, you’ll face wave after wave of emojis that rush, leap, explode, or even summon others to fight. Defeat them to collect glowing orbs, level up, and unlock upgrades or powerful new weapons. Each decision shapes your survival — will you go for raw power, faster reloads, or explosive mayhem?

Survive long enough, and you’ll uncover new arenas, more upgrades, and deeper chaos for your next run.

Can you conquer the casino before the emojis claim you?
70010000118193.intro: Shoot, dodge, kill, upgrade, unlock... do not let a single emoji escape!
70010000118193.name: Emoji Killer – Casino Massacre

70010000121658.description:
Tokyo never sleeps, and neither does she.

On stage, she's everything the crowd wants: radiant, untouchable, a star built from lights and choreography.
Off stage, she moves through a different world entirely, one with its own rules, its own silence, and its own kind of danger.

Tokyo Yakuza Idols: Save the Heart of a Rebel Girl is a narrative visual novel where romance and risk share the same heartbeat.
You didn't go looking for her.
But now that she's let you close, walking away isn't really an option anymore.

Each girl carries a story split between two lives: the performer the world sees and the woman hidden underneath the glamour and the shadows.

Ambition, loyalty, pain, rebellion. Every route pulls you deeper into who she really is.

Your choices determine whether she stays trapped between her worlds...
or finally finds someone worth choosing over all of it.


Features:

● DUAL LIVES, ONE HEART: Each character lives between the idol spotlight and the yakuza underworld, and both sides of her matter.

● IMPACTFUL CHOICES: Your decisions shape how far she trusts you, and how the story ends.

● EXCLUSIVE SCENES: Unlock intimate moments that reveal the truth behind the performance and the danger.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Escape together, get pulled into her world, lose her to it, or change everything.

● WIN HER HEART IN 30 DAYS: You have one month to earn her heart. Every decision counts, every moment matters, and time waits for no one.


She built walls to survive.
Are you capable of conquering her heart?
70010000121658.intro:
She performs under spotlights. She rules in the shadows.
And somehow, she chose to let you in.
Can you handle both sides of her?
70010000121658.name: Tokyo Yakuza Idols: Save the Heart of a Rebel Girl

70010000123348.description:
Welcome to Cozy Pages, a cozy/kawaii coloring game designed for those quiet, feel-good moments. Pick a page, choose a palette that matches your mood, add a few cute stickers and let everything slow down. No pressure, no timers. Just soft vibes, gentle creativity and that satisfying feeling when a scene comes to life.

Color charming 2D pages, from simple doodles and bold, easy designs to mandalas, lettering, and more detailed realistic drawings. Plus plenty of cute animals, cozy everyday moments and adorably decorated little houses.

Then switch things up with our separate 3D & Voxel mode, where you color blocky models and unlock whiteboards for free drawing, quick doodles and cozy creativity anytime.

This free edition gives you a warm, complete starter set:
- 33 coloring pages from different themes
- 4 voxel 3D models 
- 1 sticker pack (10 stickers)
- 2 palettes (32 colors)

It’s enough to relax right away and discover what style you love most.

And if you want the complete set, the full version—sold separately as the Cozy Bundle—includes: 450+ pages, 33 themed collections, 40 voxel 3D models, all sticker packs (110 stickers total), all palettes (192 colors total), plus 20 whiteboards for drawing freely. 

Controls

70010000123862.description:
Fluffy Friends Cute Preschool is the perfect first learning game for preschoolers! Featuring 15 carefully crafted mini games set in a breathtaking forest full of rivers, colourful trees and adorable zoo animals, this is early education at its most enchanting. 
Children count exotic animals, compare groups, train their memory, find the biggest and smallest creatures, and tap numbers in the correct order — all brought to life with beautiful animations and delightful sounds designed to keep little ones engaged and motivated. 
Whether played together or explored independently, Fluffy Friends Cute Preschool makes every learning moment feel like a magical adventure in the forest. 

WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN 
Counting and number recognition Comparing groups and sizes Memory and observation skills Logical ordering and sequencing Species recognition and categorisation 

15 MINI GAMES INCLUDE 
Did you see this animal? Which animal did you not see? Which group has the most animals? Count all animals and species Find the biggest and smallest animal Remember the order and tap correctly Memory and much more!
70010000123862.intro: Count and discover with lions, monkeys and exotic animals in a magical forest!
70010000123862.name: Fluffy Friends - Cute Preschool

70010000124215.description:
Step into a thrilling cooperative adventure where two heroes are forever connected by an unbreakable chain. Every battle, puzzle, and obstacle must be overcome together as you explore dangerous worlds filled with deadly enemies, hidden traps, and unexpected challenges.

Success depends on teamwork, communication, and trust. Use the chain to cross impossible gaps, rescue your partner from danger, and solve creative environmental puzzles. Every decision affects both players, making cooperation the only path to survival.

Key Features:
• Local Co-Op: Play the entire adventure with a friend.
• Chain Mechanics: Swing, pull, climb, and solve puzzles together.
• Cooperative Combat: Defeat enemies through teamwork.
• Deadly Challenges: Survive traps and dangerous environments.
• Shared Journey: Every victory depends on both players.

Only players who work together can conquer every challenge. Master the chain, overcome every obstacle, and prove that true teamwork is the greatest strength of all.
70010000124215.intro: Every battle is easier when you fight together.
70010000124215.name: Chained Up Together: Co-Op Duo

70010000125649.description:
Doggie Underworld: A Rhythmic Journey

Play as Claire, a witch who journeys into the mysterious Doggie Underworld with one simple goal: Finding her lost Pup!

As you travel through Doggie Underworld, you'll encounter countless souls, each with a story to tell. Share moments with them, play together, and listen to their heartfelt tales. Use your sense of rhythm to lift their spirits and ease their troubles, bringing you one beat closer to reuniting with your own lost Pup.

The Heart of the Game

As a visual novel with rhythm mechanics, the story moves forward as you succeed in rhythm challenges. Alongside her new demon friend, Lunne, Claire learns to deepen her connection with doggie spirits, uncovering stories of friendship, love, and loss.  Every rhythm challenge is unique, along with remixes and bonus features.
70010000125649.intro: Journey through the Doggie Underworld in this heartwarming rhythm and visual novel hybrid.
70010000125649.name: Puppergeist

70010000127073.description:
The summer roster has one spot left, and everyone on the sand is just as determined to take it as you are. Somewhere between the drills and the downtime, it stopped being just about volleyball.

One reads every play before it happens. One stays guarded until you've actually earned a place in his world. Another is warm and easy until the score gets close, then turns sharp and unreadable. And the captain isn't letting anyone in who hasn't proven he's worth the risk.

Say the right thing and something shifts. Say the wrong thing and you're back on the bench. Thirty days until the season opener, and every day you wait is a day someone else gets closer.


Features:

● A ROSTER FULL OF UNFORGETTABLE GUYS: A deep bench, and every player is a completely different reason to fall. None of them easy. All of them worth the effort.

● DIALOGUE CHOICES THAT MATTER: Every response shifts the relationship. Say the wrong thing and you lose ground. Get it right and something real starts to open up.

● CHARACTER AFFINITY SYSTEM: Build genuine connection through practices, late nights, and moments away from the crowd. The harder the pursuit, the more it means when he finally lets you close.

● EXCLUSIVE GALLERY IMAGES: Unlock beautiful illustrations as each bond deepens. Every guy is hiding a story he's not ready to hand you for free.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your path through the season is yours to shape. Not every route ends in romance, but every one of them is worth playing out.

● 30 DAYS TO MAKE THE TEAM: The season opener is locked in and the countdown has already started. Waste a day, and someone else closes the distance instead of you.


One roster. One summer. Only one spot opens up, and it might cost you more than you think.

Which one are you chasing?
70010000127073.intro:
The roster's stacked. One spot open. Every match could change everything.
Think you can win them over before the season starts?
70010000127073.name: Beach Volleyball Boys: Hot Spike

70010000127351.description:
Turn fitness into a fun, motivating, and interactive furry experience.

Choose your personal trainer, select your level, and begin your custom fitness journey through structured workouts that keep you challenged and inspired.

Each session combines 7 different exercises, performed for 1 minute 30 seconds with short 30-second breaks — repeated twice for a full 28-minute workout plus warm-up. With over 100 exercises, there are endless variations to keep every session fresh.

Build your personal training schedule across weeks or months, earn rewards for staying consistent, and watch your strength and endurance grow. Each trainer brings unique energy, voice, and encouragement to help you stay motivated.

Vibrant visuals, dynamic environments, and pumping music transform every workout into a fitness adventure. Whether you’re just starting out or chasing peak performance.

This game will help you to stay active, healthy, and motivated long-term.
70010000127351.intro: Train with hot furries, push your limits, and get stronger with every session!
70010000127351.name: GET FIT - Furry Edition

70010000127800.description:
Japan Stigmatized Property2

We appreciate your dedicated efforts in the previous surveillance operation.
Please be advised that the risk level for the current assignment has significantly increased.
You are required to exercise extreme caution while performing your duties.

You are an observer for the "Japan Stigmatized Property Association" (JSP).
Your duty is to monitor surveillance cameras installed in designated properties and check for any anomalies.
Upon discovering an anomaly, you must report it immediately.
Repeated failure to report or excessive false reports will result in "Mission Failure." Conversely, maintaining successful surveillance from 00:00 to 05:00 constitutes "Mission Success."

【Operational Features】
Real-World Locations: You will be assigned to properties that actually exist in Japan.
Randomized Anomalies: Irregularities occur randomly.
Camera Modes: Be vigilant for phenomena visible only through specific equipment (Night Vision or Standard Camera).

【Examples of Anomalies】
Movement of furniture; disappearance or appearance of objects.
Intrusion by human figures or spiritual entities.
Lighting malfunctions; floating orbs.
Bloodstains on walls; video feed noise/interference.
"Something" beyond imagination.

【Shift Details】
Assignment: 4 total properties.
Hours: 00:00 – 05:00 (Midnight shift).
Difficulty: Selectable between "Normal" and "Special Pay" (Hard).

【Others】
Streaming and broadcasting while conducting duties is permitted.
We place no restrictions on monetization or Super Chats.
Submission of permission requests is not required for either individuals or corporate entities.

Please commence your duties.
70010000127800.intro:
Can you survive until dawn?
Monitor real Japanese properties and report every anomaly.
70010000127800.name: Japan Stigmatized Property2 -日本事故物件監視協会-

70010000128133.description:
Your greatest weapons are your spatial reasoning and your ability to guide a rolling ball across a cube's shifting surfaces. Decode complex 2D layouts, solve the intricate mazes etched into these geometric structures, and bypass the ultimate security matrix to awaken the 3D artifacts sealed within.

◆ Overview
Enter a mysterious cyberspace, a digital void left behind by a forgotten civilization. Floating within this realm are cryptic boxes trapping enigmatic 3D objects.

At first glance, they appear to be simple cubes. However, their surfaces are protected by a highly advanced security system: a series of intricate 3D mazes. By steering your ball across these shifting faces and navigating to the goal, you will breach the security matrix and liberate the unknown anomalies slumbering inside.

◆ Key Features

 - Decode the 2D Layouts: Test the limits of your spatial awareness. Instantly visualize how flat 2D layouts fold into complex 3D structures to find the correct path forward.
 - Dynamic 3D Mazes: Navigate a rolling ball across the shifting faces of geometric cubes, mastering gravity and perspective.
 - Cyber-Ancient Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in a mysterious digital void with an ambient soundtrack that fuels your focus.
70010000128133.intro: Introducing a whole new genre: "Mental Rotation Maze" Test your flash of inspiration in this spatial brain teaser—can you visualize the 3D maze hidden within a flat net?
70010000128133.name: Hako Maze

70010000128938.description:
Enjoy the slow life in a peaceful countryside village.
Hunt for bugs in forests, bamboo groves, rivers, and more.
Meet the villagers, make new friends, and create unforgettable summer memories.

Insects from across the globe gather in the mysterious woods.
Legendary insects are even said to dwell deep within.
Fill out your Bug Records and become a master bug collector!

[Simple Bug Catching]
Bug catching controls are simple!
Approach without startling the bug, then swing your net at the right time!
Catch the bugs before they escape!

[70+ Species to Catch!]
Catch bugs native to Japan as well as from around the world!
Complete your Bug Records by collecting data on every bug you catch.
Find every species and hunt for record-breaking sizes!

[Collect Bug Nets and Items]
Save up your allowance to buy new bug nets and items for bug catching.
Use items to increase your chances of finding rare and large bugs!

[Bug Battles]
Put the bugs you've caught to the test in exciting battles!
Knock your opponent's bug out of the battle zone!
Find the strongest bug you can and become the champion!

[Interact with the Villagers]
Spend time with your friends and the local villagers.
Help them out, play minigames, and enjoy summer vacation to its fullest!

[Decorate Your Secret Base!]
Freely decorate your secret base with the furniture you collect.
Pick your favorite items to display and make the space your own!

[Online Rankings]
Compete to capture as many bugs as you can within the time limit in Score Attack!
Climb the leaderboards with your best Score Attack score and total bugs caught.
Test your skills against players from around the world!
70010000128938.intro:
Pick up your bug net and set off on a grand summer adventure.
Your bug-collecting summer vacation is about to begin!
70010000128938.name: Peaceful Bug Catching Story

70010000130425.description:
Start with just a handful of arcade machines and a small budget, then grow your business into the ultimate entertainment destination. Every machine earns money, every upgrade attracts more customers, and every decision shapes the future of your arcade.

Expand your floor with new game cabinets, purchase furniture, and unlock bigger, better attractions as your arcade grows. Manage your profits wisely, reinvest in your business, and transform a tiny game room into a thriving arcade empire.

Features:
> Start with a small arcade and expand over time.
> Buy a variety of arcade machines.
> Earn money from customers and reinvest your profits.
> Purchase furniture to improve your arcade's appearance.
> Build the ultimate arcade and become the best in town!

Will you create the most popular arcade in town?
70010000130425.intro: Build your dream arcade from the ground up!
70010000130425.name: Build My Arcade

70010000132780.description:
Word Hive 2 is a word puzzle game where each puzzle gives you seven letters: six outer letters and one required center letter. Use them to create as many words as possible. 

Every word must include the center letter. Letters may be used more than once, and each word must contain at least four letters. Longer words earn more points, while special words that use all seven letters, known as pangrams, award bonus points. 

Put your mind to the test with every puzzle, discover new words, expand your vocabulary, and enjoy a rewarding word puzzle experience. 

Increase your score to climb the ranks, uncover every hidden word, and become the ultimate word master. 

Word Hive 2 uses an American English dictionary. 

Features 
• Play through 2,000 all-new word puzzle levels 
• Discover special words called pangrams by using all seven letters 
• Learn new English words and expand your vocabulary as you play 
• Compete with players around the world on the online leaderboard 
• Resume your last game and continue where you left off 
• Play in Handheld Mode, Tabletop Mode, or TV Mode
70010000132780.intro: Build words, score points, and master the hive.
70010000132780.name: WordHive 2

70010000133423.description:
Welcome to Digging for Dinosaurs – a gorgeous interactive experience brought to you by The ©Smithsonian and PlayDate Digital! This is a must-have adventure for dino explorers of any age, where you can dig up fossils and open up a prehistoric world filled with facts, pterosaurs, giant sea reptiles and every kind of prehistoric dinosaur!

EXPLORE every layer of a vibrant and prehistoric world with virtual fossil hunter tools!
LEARN fun and surprising facts about Dinosaurs!
DISCOVER the reptiles that flew, swam and stalked the Earth!

Explore the different time periods when Dinosaurs dominated the land, air, and sea, through guided play, puzzles and digging up fossils and facts. The more you dig, the more you will discover! Earning coins let’s you select new more powerful tools to dig up our prehistoric past. Each new dig is an opportunity for budding paleontologists to crack rocks, brush away dirt, assemble fossils and uncover new dinosaurs and new dinosaur facts! Each dinosaur discovery is rewarded with interactive scenes packed with learning moments and interesting information. Collect all the creature cards and then come back for more!

Think you know your dinosaurs facts? Test your knowledge with a Prehistoric Quiz, earn more dino coins, and keep digging with even better fossil hunting tools!

We’ll see you at the dig site!

Features:
• Learn about more than 15 dinosaur species including Tyrannosaurus rex, Triceratops, and the Velociraptor!
• Unlock dinosaur cards, packed with interesting info about each prehistoric creature you dig up!
• Explore a prehistoric and interactive world that fills with more dinosaurs as you discover them!
• Dig up fossils, test your dino knowledge, and collect creature cards!
• Earn dino coins to unlock better digging tools—without spending any additional ‘real’ money!
• Phonetic spelling helps you sound out and learn exciting new words
• Engaging educational content and beautiful illustrations based on the original Dinosaurs book!
• Learn about all the different Dinosaur ages!

There is something for kids at every level in Digging For Dinosaurs – from cracking rocks and digging up fossils to brushing up on the latest Dino knowledge!

Learning goals:
• Dinosaur knowledge: Learn the names of dinosaurs, what they ate and how they lived.
• Literacy Skills: practiced through reading and creative play about dinosaurs!
• Vocabulary: Learn new words with phonetic spelling and pronunciation.
• Critical thinking: learn what life was like for all the different types of dinosaurs in all their different environments and ages!
70010000133423.intro: A interactive adventure where young explorers excavate fossils, discover prehistoric creatures, and learn through play in a safe, engaging experience designed for curious kids.
70010000133423.name: Smithsonian: Digging For Dinosaurs

70050000075928.description:
Wobbly Life is a vibrant open-world physics sandbox. Play with your friends online or in local co-op, with exciting jobs, mini games and wacky story missions. Earn cash to spend in the world on clothes, vehicles and houses. There is a whole Wobbly World out there to explore!

Grandma has kicked you out into the big wide Wobbly world demanding you go and GET A JOB! She would be so proud if you could earn some money and get your own house one day! 

It's time to start earning and living your best Wobbly Life! 

Includes Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition features:
- GameShare: Play Wobbly Life with anyone – even if they don't own the game! 
- GameChat: Share audio and video while playing with your friends. 
- Start where you left off on Nintendo Switch™ with forwards compatible save game to Nintendo Switch™ 2
- 1-4 players online and local split screen co-op

Open-world sandbox filled with mini-games, toys, secrets and SO MUCH more 

+100 unique missions & jobs with exclusive rewards to unlock, alone or with friends 

+90 vehicles to ride around (and crash)

+500 clothes items to show-off in your wobbly look 

+infinite number of wobbly fun! 
 
FUN, FRIENDS & PHYSICS!

Let's start exploring! Almost everything is interactive – grab, play, and experiment in a world filled with props, mini-games, and surprises.  

Experience the joy of individual quests and shared adventures with up to 4 players in online or local co-op, all in one fantastical world. 

MYSTERIES AND MISSIONS

Embark on story missions, each offering unique rewards through satisfying puzzles and challenges. Unveil the mysteries of the tropical island, uncover the mountain’s secrets, delve into hidden caves...  

The Wobbly Museum has lost all its artifacts! Maybe you can help? Buy treasure maps and solve clues to find all the Museums' lost treasures and unlock fun rewards. 

GO GET A JOB!

Make grandma happy and go get that job! Earn money by choosing from +20 exciting jobs, each bringing their new unique challenges. From pizza delivery to firefighting, taxi driver to disco dancer… your wobbly dream job is waiting for you. 

LIVE THE HIGH WOBBLY LIFE! 

Once you’ve fattened up your bank account why not go on a shopping spree? Visit the Pet Shop to buy a faithful companion, buy and unlock +500 clothes items and choose from +90 different vehicles.  

When you’ve really made the big bucks, you can even buy a house: from a wooden shack to a huge fancy mansion, Wobbly Island has a home for everyone whatever your taste! 

PLAY YOUR OWN WAY WITH ARCADE MODE

Want to take a break from the Wobbly Island? Try out the Arcade mode! Discover four new game modes: Trash Zone, Hide & Seek, Wobble Run and Sandbox. Each have customizable settings for you to play with, multiple mini-games and new areas to have fun in!

GO TO SPACE! The Wobbly Space Programme is looking for new recruits. Space is a whole new open world, with new jobs, missions, and secrets to uncover. You'll even get to fly your own spaceships too, so what are you waiting for!
70050000075928.name: Wobbly Life - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack

70070000037751.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™ controllers. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!

This bundle includes base game, London Rules, Streets Supplement and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•    10 new vehicles
•    The new rules and 10 new stages await you
70070000037751.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000037751.name: Urban Flow Enhanced Edition

70070000038066.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Food Truck Tycoon Asian Cuisine" and "Pizza Bar Tycoon".
70070000038066.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000038066.name: Cooking Arena Infinite Edition

70070000038630.description:
Put your dueling instincts to the test in one-on-one matches!

Choose from multiple characters with their signature ability shots.
Pick their looks from the list of available outfits.
Make them better players by improving their stats!

Challenge your mates in one-on-one local multiplayer mode! 

Shoot, block, shove and dunk your way through tournaments to unlock additional characters.

The must-have game for all basketball lovers!

GAME FEATURES:

* 19 different characters with their own signature ability shots and unique looks
* Two different single player modes (League and Challenge)
* COMPETE 1-ON-1 IN LOCAL MULTIPLAYER MODE (Versus)
* Improve your character by leveling up and upgrading their stats
* Amazing graphics, music and sound effects
* 36 achievements to complete

This bundle contains main title and Street Style Kit #4, with:

70070000038630.name: Street Basketball Upgrade Edition

70070000039154.description:
A cat's life
Explore Pawbay by taking on important feline duties, from mail delivery to catching pigeons, as you impress (or infuriate!) the town's citizens. Dress up your cat, explore the town and adventure alone or in local co-op. 

Cat parkour!
Climb onto rooftops, jump between clotheslines and find hidden shortcuts using simple controls and forgiving movement that keeps the adventure accessible for everyone.

Now dressed for the job
Dress up by combining fur patterns with unlockable hats and face accessories. Whether you put on a police cap or a chef's hat, the town will get to see you're a mature cat!

A busy schedule!
How much work is in a cat's day? Steal fish, find the most luxurious furniture to scratch, and show off in cat races, as you discover ways to impress the locals and keep up with a feline's busy life!
• Explore a lively town, getting in the way of or assisting its citizens
• Dress up by combining fur patterns with unlockable hats and face accessories
• Work alone or add an extra set of paws in local co-op
• Explore the town freely or try to complete the challenge list for each area!
70070000039154.intro: Be the cat your parents hoped for!

* All sticker packs (110 stickers total)
