* 20 whiteboards for drawing freely (quick doodles, sketches, and calm creative play)

Controls
Choose your favorite way to play:
* Motion pointer (Joy-Con™): move the pointer by tilting the controller like a magic wand.
* Touchscreen: tap and color directly for a smooth, hands-on experience.

Tools
Keep it simple or get creative: use cozy tools like brushes (with different looks), a satisfying fill bucket, an eraser, glitter and sticker stamps to decorate your pages. 

Cozy Pages is your pocket of calm: cute, cozy and always ready when you need a little break.
70070000039232.name: Cozy Bundle: 450+ Coloring Pages & Goodies + All Stickers, Palettes & Whiteboards

70070000039250.description:
Step into a brutal overrun by the undead in Cowboys vs Zombies, a fast-paced roguelike action experience where survival depends on your skill, strategy, and firepower. 

Every run is a new challenge. Combine abilities, upgrade your gear, and choose loyal pets to support you in battle, each bringing their own unique strengths to the fight. Face dangerous elites and powerful bosses that will push your reflexes and tactics to the limit as you carve your path through the apocalypse.

This bundle includes the main title, the Killer Guns DLC, the Gold Rush DLC, and the Western Duo DLC, delivering even more firepower, rewards, and characters to your adventure. Gain access to powerful new weapons to dominate the battlefield, earn a massive coin boost to upgrade your arsenal faster, and recruit two additional cowboys ready to ride into danger. With these additions, you’ll have more ways than ever to customize your playstyle, strengthen your build, and survive the relentless undead threat.

Load your weapons, saddle up, and prove you have what it takes to reclaim the frontier from the dead.
70070000039250.intro: Run fast, shoot faster, survive longer!
70070000039250.name: Cowboys vs Zombies GOLD EDITION

70070000039265.description:
Feel the adrenaline of unstoppable speed in Highway Legends, a high-octane driving experience where every road becomes a test of reflexes, control, and courage. Race through breathtaking environments, from dense urban highways to vast open landscapes, dodging traffic and pushing your limits in a constant pursuit of perfection on asphalt.

Customize and upgrade a powerful fleet of high-performance vehicles, each built for speed, style, and precision. Master intense highway runs where every decision matters and every second counts as you carve your path toward becoming a true road legend.

This bundle includes the main title, the Triple Threat on Street DLC, and the Road to Riches DLC, giving you access to three elite high-performance cars and a massive coin boost to accelerate your progression. Expand your garage, enhance your vehicles, and unlock new levels of customization and power to dominate every stretch of road.

Push the pedal to the metal, outdrive the competition, and become the ultimate Highway Legend.
70070000039265.name: Highway Legends GOLD EDITION

70070000039275.description:
Step into the world of precision driving and creativity in Car Parking Legends, where mastering the art of parking is only the beginning. Explore a rich driving experience filled with detailed car handling, deep customization, and engaging game modes that challenge both your skill and imagination. From tight urban spaces to complex parking scenarios, every challenge pushes you closer to becoming a true parking master.

Customize your vehicles with a wide range of upgrades, visual modifications, and performance tweaks. Personalize your driver with unique outfits and accessories, and choose from a diverse lineup of cars, each offering distinct handling and driving feel. Whether you're progressing through Career Mode, taking on the role of a parking attendant, or freely exploring a lively city, every drive offers something new.

This bundle includes the main title and the Ultimate Riders DLC, introducing two expert drivers with unique skills and fresh challenges designed to test your precision to the limit. Navigate advanced parking zones, overcome new obstacles, and refine your technique with these highly skilled characters by your side.

Park with style, drive with precision, and become a true legend of the lot.
70070000039275.intro: Master the art of perfect parking.
70070000039275.name: Car Parking Legends DELUXE EDITION

70010000093178.description:
Hello, Agent. Mega City needs your services. Are you ready to uphold the law?

The crime is out of control, the streets are not clean. There are criminals and psychopaths everywhere, ready to cut anyone’s throat. A corrupt megacorporation squeezes the life out of the citizens, seeking to establish control all over the city.
Only the incorruptible agents of Mega City Task Force stand fast before the crime wave that consumed the city and threatens to overwhelm society.
Choose your agent and dive into a deadly battle against the criminals and brutal bosses to unleash the beast of justice in the darkest corners of the city.

DISCOVER THE MUSIC OF DROID BISHOP, TIMECOP1983, SUBLUNAR, AND MORE!
Defeat bosses to collect iconic synth-wave tracks on audio cassettes. Set up a special audio player within the Headquarters to immerse yourself in their mesmerizing melodies.

HARDCORE GAMEPLAY WITH TONS OF WEAPONS AND UPGRADES
Shoot, punch and use your abilities to destroy enemies at every level where you will find special boxes containing various weapons. Remember to collect money from enemies, they can be spent at the store to get new equipment and special contracts.
Each level and every enemy is designed to hone your skills by utilizing each agent’s arsenal to its fullest, ensuring you will fight crime in the most effective way possible. Quick reaction and tactical thinking will be required to succeed.

EVERY AGENT BOASTS A UNIQUE TACTICAL PLAYSTYLE
Become a brutal killing machine like a Cyborg who has three weapon slots, improved armor, and a magnetic pulse that interrupts attacks and stun enemies.
Take on the classic role of a Rookie using a tactical dodge and stun grenade.
Turn into a fast and extremely dangerous Scout with a lightweight frame and optical camouflage staying invisible to enemies and using her laser sight to inflict critical damage when the time is right.
These are just a few of the agents available from the start. Unlock more characters with unique tactical abilities as you go!

PIXEL ART VISUAL STYLE INSPIRED BY THE 80S AND THE 90S ACTION MOVIES AND VIDEO GAMES
Do you remember the good old days when tough action heroes dispatched enemies with cool moves to a banging soundtrack? The entire game is imbued with the same retro spirit. Each pixel, each gun, and each item were crafted to give you that nostalgic feeling, from retro dudes for retro dudes with true love.

HIGH REPLAYABILITY, A ROBUST PROGRESSION SYSTEM, AND PROCEDURALLY GENERATED LEVELS
What happens when crime is vanquished? It comes back with a vengeance. Completing the game for the first time unlocks a new difficulty and more loadouts with instantly recognizable legendary outfits. Uphold the law in style.
70010000093178.intro: Retrowave Action Roguelike featuring tough agents battling crime! Choose your agent and dive into hardcore action against enemies and bosses, utilizing a vast arsenal and special abilities
70010000093178.name: Mega City Force

70010000093241.description:
Dying of frostbite, Gréta Egilsdóttir is left to wonder how she found herself in such a dire situation. 

Perhaps it began with Steina’s baby, or with Kai agreeing to stay the night, or with that kiss she almost shared with Nataníel.

Perhaps it began when she journeyed from her home to work as a housemaid in the distant fishing village… 

Or perhaps it began three years ago, when her grandmother was still alive. For Gréta, meeting Nataníel Jóhannsson was love at first sight…

But there are some loves which cannot — or perhaps should not — be.


Features
* Dramatic linear visual novel
* 120,000 words
* Beautiful original art and music
* Emotional story with memorable characters
70010000093241.intro: Follow Gréta, as she finds herself caught between the affections of three men who care for her in different ways.
70010000093241.name: With Eyes of Ice

70010000126803.description:
Explore the frontier as Kero Kero, a cowboy frog on a quest to bring peace and justice to the Wild West. Use your extendable tongue, trusty six-shooter, and wits to conquer the wildest outlaws of the west. Yeehaw!

Face dastardly foes, perilous platforming challenges, and intense shootouts across deserts, mines, mountains, trains, forests, and beyond!

Kero Kero features an array of techniques and abilities to help him on his quest. He can eat enemies, spit them back out, or even brandish a giant revolver to dispatch far-off foes! But be aware, a 6-shooter only has room for 6 bullets, so use them wisely! He can also swim with ease, ride in a giant cowboy boot to stomp enemies, ride rails in a mine cart, and spit hot fire after eating a spicy jalapeño pepper. How to best utilize his abilities in each scenario is up to you, the player!

Features:

- 25 levels of rootin' tootin' retro platforming action!
- 5 intense & challenging boss fights!
- Special collectibles that unlock extra-challenging bonus levels!
- In-game music player to jam out to the Kero Kero Cowboy original soundtrack!
- Diverse environments to explore, including deserts, mines, trains, forests, mountains, and more!
70010000126803.intro: Kero Kero Cowboy is a cartoony western themed retro style platformer!
70010000126803.name: Kero Kero Cowboy

70010000127085.description:
Step into a calming yet deeply satisfying experience in House Cleaner Simulator, where every mess is a chance to create something beautiful. Take on the role of a professional cleaner and transform cluttered, dirty spaces into spotless, cozy homes. From small apartments to large houses, each job brings new challenges and visible results you can truly enjoy.

Features:
	•	Detailed cleaning mechanics including trash removal, surface scrubbing, floor washing, and object organization.
	•	Variety of jobs with unique conditions and different levels of dirt and complexity.
	•	Wide selection of tools and equipment with upgrade options to improve efficiency.
	•	Progression system with new contracts, larger locations, and more demanding tasks.
	•	Equipment customization and upgrades that enhance speed and cleaning performance.
	•	Client satisfaction system based on precision, completeness, and overall results.
	•	Relaxing gameplay focused on attention to detail and satisfying visual transformations.

Turn chaos into cleanliness and restore every space to perfection. In House Cleaner Simulator, your precision and dedication define your success. Build your reputation, take on bigger challenges, and become the ultimate cleaning professional.
70010000127085.intro: Build your reputation with every perfectly cleaned home.
70010000127085.name: House Cleaner Simulator

70010000130768.description:
Welcome to Hearthwater, a cozy exploration game where there's no combat, no timers, and no pressure—just a beautiful village waiting to be explored. Wander along sandy beaches, stroll through quiet streets, and venture into forests, hills, and hidden paths as you uncover every location the village has to offer.

Take your time soaking in the relaxing atmosphere while searching for landmarks, secret spots, and scenic viewpoints. Every path leads to something new, encouraging you to explore at your own pace and experience the charm of Hearthwater.

Features
> Explore a peaceful seaside village.
> Discover every unique location and hidden area.
> Relax with a cozy, stress-free exploration experience.
> Immerse yourself in a calm atmosphere.
> Take your time—there are no timers, combat, or pressure.

Every path has a story. Every corner is waiting to be discovered.
70010000130768.intro: Escape to a peaceful seaside village and discover every hidden corner.
70010000130768.name: Hearthwater

70070000038669.description: Roots + Viking Farm + ZenWash + Tiny Little Farm
70070000038669.name: Farm 2+

70010000130588.description:
Welcome to Mireglow, a cosy exploration game where the only goal is to wander, discover, and enjoy the journey. Explore a tranquil swamp glowing with magical plants, ancient trees, quiet waterways, and forgotten paths as you search for every unique location hidden throughout the world.

Features
>Explore a beautiful mystical swamp.
>Discover every hidden location and secret area.
>Relax in a cosy, stress-free adventure.
>Wander through glowing marshes, ancient forests, and quiet waterways.
>Enjoy a calm and immersive atmosphere.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration.

Lose yourself in the glow of the swamp and discover every hidden corner of Mireglow.
70010000130588.intro: Step into a peaceful mystical swamp filled with wonder and hidden discoveries.
70010000130588.name: Mireglow

70010000132171.description:
BLOCKY POWERS — The Ultimate 2-Player Physics Block Party!

Grab a controller, invite a friend, and get ready for the most chaotic, fast-paced, and hilarious block-stacking duel! Blocky Powers takes the timeless excitement of falling block puzzles and combines it with unpredictable real-time physics, tricky strategies, and non-stop 1v1 local multiplayer mayhem.

Whether you are looking for the perfect couch showdown or a fierce competitive trial against a rival, Blocky Powers delivers an unforgettable head-to-head battle experience where every single block counts and no towers are ever truly safe!
REAL PHYSICS & THE MIGHTY WIND!

Forget rigid grids and predictable placements—in Blocky Powers, real physics reign supreme! Drop, rotate, and balance classic falling blocks to build the tallest, most stable towers imaginable.

Every block you place sways, shifts, and reacts to dynamic gravity. But physics isn't your only challenge—watch out for strong environmental winds that will test your tower’s stability to the absolute limit! Do you have the engineering precision and quick reflexes needed to construct epic towers and fight off the howling wind under pressure?
SABOTAGE YOUR RIVAL — PLACE BLOCKS ON THEIR TOWER!

Building a high tower is only half the battle. What makes Blocky Powers the ultimate local multiplayer experience is the unique, direct sabotage mechanic!

Instead of using distant spells, you can use tricky tactics to drop tricky blocks directly onto your opponent's screen and structure!

    Throw Off Their Balance: Send awkward, heavy, or unevenly shaped blocks straight over to your rival’s side.

    Ruined Precision: Ruin their carefully built foundation and watch their tower wobble under the sudden extra weight!

Timing is everything. Send a tricky block right when your friend is placing a critical piece and force their hard work to come tumbling down!
INTENSE 2-PLAYER LOCAL MULTIPLAYER BATTLES

Blocky Powers is built from the ground up for maximum 1v1 head-to-head action! Plug in an extra controller and jump into instant same-screen party battles with 2 players.

    Extra Controller Couch Play: Grab a second controller and battle side-by-side on a single screen! Perfect for rivalry nights, casual gaming sessions, and competitive duels on the couch.

    Custom Battle Rules: Tweak game settings, adjust wind forces, or set block drop speeds to create your own custom 2-player battle rules.

GAME MODES: RACE & SURVIVAL

Master your block-stacking skills across two thrilling game modes designed to test your reflexes, strategy, and patience:

    Race Mode (Build to the Top): Who can build the tallest towers and cross the finish line first? Speed is key, but build too fast without balance—or get sabotaged by a rival block—and watch your tower crash!

    Survival Mode (Keep It Balanced): You only have a limited number of life-hearts. Don't let your falling blocks drop into the abyss below—stack carefully, fight the wind, and survive the blocks thrown onto your tower by your opponent!

KEY FEATURES:

    Physics-Based Stacking Mechanics: Experience dynamic block physics where balance, weight, and center of gravity dictate survival.

    Direct Block Sabotage: Use tricky tactics to place extra blocks directly onto your opponent's tower to ruin their balance.

    Environmental Wind Effects: Battle unpredictable gusts of wind that push and sway your towers.

    2-Player Local Multiplayer: Seamless head-to-head play—grab an extra controller and battle your friend on the same screen!

    Race & Survival Modes: Challenge your rival in high-speed tower races or tense survival showdowns.

Put on your hard hat, master real physics, defeat the wind, throw tricky blocks onto your opponent's side, and stack your way to victory in Blocky Powers! Will your towers reach the sky, or will your friend send them tumbling down?
70010000132171.intro: Stack falling blocks with real physics! Build the tallest balanced towers, unleash tricky powers, and dominate local multiplayer!
70010000132171.name: Blocky Powers

70010000132194.description:
Welcome to Suncroft, a cosy exploration game where every street and hidden corner invites you to slow down and enjoy the journey!

Take your time strolling through the town, discovering hidden paths, relaxing by fountains, and uncovering charming landmarks scattered throughout the world. With no combat, no timers, and no pressure, Suncroft is all about exploring at your own pace and soaking in its warm, welcoming atmosphere.

Features
>Explore a handcrafted sunny town.
>Discover every unique location and hidden area.
>Enjoy a relaxing, stress-free exploration experience.
>Immerse yourself in a warm and peaceful atmosphere.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration
70010000132194.name: Suncroft

70010000132577.description:
You awaken alone in a decaying prison with no memory of how you got there. The cells are empty, the lights barely work, and every hallway echoes with unsettling silence. Something feels wrong.

Will you find the way out before it's too late?

Features
>Explore a large abandoned prison filled with secrets.
>Solve puzzles to unlock new areas and escape.
>Experience tense first-person horror with immersive sound design.
>Uncover the mystery behind the prison's abandonment.
70010000132577.name: Horror Prison: Escape

70010000133425.description:
Ducks In Disguise is a peaceful hidden-object game focused on discovering beauty within the chaos. Explore hand-drawn 2D scenes, each with its own atmosphere, and find the ducks hiding around every corner!

Hundreds of ducks have decided to play the biggest game of hide-and-seek ever! Your task is simple: carefully examine each scene, find the hidden ducks and complete your collection. But not every duck is easy to spot. Some have disguised themselves to blend into their surroundings, so you’ll need to pay close attention to the details to find them.

As you explore each scene, click on objects and interact with your surroundings. Sometimes a duck is hiding right in front of you, while other times you’ll need to interact with the environment to reveal it. Every duck you find brings you one step closer to completing your collection.

A Stress-Free Experience

In Ducks In Disguise, there are no time limits, high-score pressures or tasks that require you to rush. Play at your own pace, listen to relaxing lo-fi music, examine each scene and enjoy the satisfaction of finding all the ducks.

Hand-Drawn 2D Worlds

Explore carefully crafted, hand-drawn illustrations, each with its own atmosphere and visual details. Take a close look at the detailed scenes and discover new ducks as you spot the little details hidden throughout the environment.

Ducks in Disguise

Not every duck hides in the same way. Some special ducks disguise themselves by blending into their surroundings. Keep your eyes peeled and don’t miss even the smallest detail!

Find Them All

Complete your collection by finishing every scene and prove that you’re a true duck-finding expert. Find every hidden duck to unlock a special reward: the Quack Certificate!

Whether you’ve got five minutes to spare or want to play for hours, Ducks In Disguise is designed to help you relax, sharpen your observation skills and discover something new in every scene.

Can you find every hidden duck? Quack! Quack!
70010000133425.intro: Discover hidden ducks, find the ones in disguise, and enjoy a peaceful hidden-object adventure across beautifully hand-drawn worlds!
70010000133425.name: Ducks In Disguise

70010000104178.description:
A Tower Full of Cats is a cozy and charming hidden object game where your mission is simple: find every cat across the entire history of catkind… and beyond!
Climb through time in this vertical, whimsical adventure packed with secrets, surprises, and—of course—cats.

Travel across beautifully illustrated levels representing different eras and worlds, each overflowing with adorable felines hiding in plain sight. Discover over 1,400 cats, uncover special items, and reveal delightful surprises as you ascend the mysterious Tower of Time.

Whether you're a completionist, a cat lover, or simply looking for a relaxing and rewarding experience, A Tower Full of Cats delivers a playful journey that keeps you smiling at every floor.

Features

- 1,400+ Cats to Find: A massive collection of unique and quirky felines hiding everywhere.
- Time-Traveling Levels: Explore different eras and fantasy settings as you climb the Tower.
- Extra Secrets: Hidden objects, bonus collectibles, special cats, and surprises in every scene.
- Adaptive Soundtrack: Music that evolves with each stage, creating a cozy and immersive ambiance.
- Relaxing Gameplay: No timers, no stress—just pure hidden-object fun focused on exploration.
- All Ages Friendly: Perfect for kids, adults, and anyone who loves cats (or discovering things!).
70010000104178.name: A Tower Full of Cats

70010000117524.description:
Fractured Worlds is a Dark Fantasy Action RPG set in a reality that has been broken into pieces by the ambition of its inhabitants. Now, guided by a mysterious voice, you must explore these broken realms, piece together the past, and confront those responsible for this cataclysmic event.

Deliberate, Precision-Based Combat
Each weapon has its own weight, speed and moveset. From two handed maces with slow staggering attacks, to nimble spears perfect for crowd controlling enemies and magic wands controlling the flow of Aether - everything plays and feels different. The classless progression system allows for multiple respecs so it’s easy to try a little bit of everything or adjust your character to a particularly powerful Legendary item you find.

Encounter Other Players
Reality's distortion means that the worlds of other players might briefly overlap with yours. You can choose to interact with them, or simply continue on your own path. You can invade and assist, support and deceive, share a profitable loot pile or lure other players into a particularly deadly mob of enemies and collect the spoils once they are dealt with.

Explore Diverse, Broken Realms 
Journey through unique procedural environments that are fragments of former worlds. Navigate medieval Dungeons, the mystical enchanted Forests, volcanic landscapes, and future industrial Cities. Find memory fragments that reveal the stories of those affected by the cataclysm, helping you understand what happened and mend the broken world.

Share a Piece of Your World
Map Shards are powerful artifacts that allow players to share a piece of their world with others. Map Shards create a co-operative instance with random modifiers that unpredictably alters the monsters that inhabit the area and boost the loot they are guarding. When sharing the area with others, players can comment on it letting everyone know about what to expect in the area: vast riches or especially challenging encounters.

Face Challenging Bosses 
Confront powerful bosses that stand in your way. Battle the Treasure Golem, the mind-altering Rorsch, the imposing Ghostly Knight, and many more. Each boss encounter is a tough and deadly challenge where a single mistake can cost you a significant chunk of your health if played poorly. But every action in these fights is thoughtfully designed and well-telegraphed, so with practice, you can conquer even the greatest foe.

Fractured Worlds offers a journey through a broken reality, focusing on direct action and the task of restoring what was lost.
70010000117524.name: Fractured Worlds

70010000120256.description:
APIDYA - A very special retro shoot 'em up buzzes into view!
Take flight in Apidya' Special, brought back through sheer Pixel Passion!

1992's home computer legend Apidya is making a comeback in this authentic 24-bit pixel remake, built from the ground up, but utterly faithful to the original.

Developed by the original team, together with a devoted Apidya super-fan-turned-developer, Apidya' Special is based on a previously abandoned 1990s console port, combining original assets with all-new pixel art, additional authentic sound effects, and remixed music. Legendary composer Chris Hülsbeck contributes exclusive new studio versions of the iconic soundtrack that has never been released before.

The warmth and charm of a CRT on modern screens!

Players can experience Apidya' Special in true widescreen with new parallax effects or switch to the original home computer 4:3 mode that looks, plays, and sounds exactly like 1992. Optional CRT effects with simulated shadow mask, scan lines, and phosphor bloom recreate the classic display feel.

Features:
• Authentic Remake – Completely rebuilt from scratch; no emulation.
• Two Visual Modes – Seamlessly switch between HD widescreen or original 4:3 presentation.
• Exclusive Chris Hülsbeck OST – New studio versions of the iconic soundtrack, never before released.
• Retro Visual Effects – Optional CRT shaders, bloom, and authentic scanline simulation.
• Expanded Worlds – 5 diverse themed worlds (Meadow, Pond, Sewers, Cyber, Lair), up to 5 levels each, 20 unique bosses, and hidden special stages.
• Fresh Surprises – Randomized in-game events like "Night Mode" with new enemy sprites.
• Co-op Mode – Team up in the all-new co-op mode, where player two controls a fully featured bee with its own weapons.
• Accessibility Options – Modernized difficulty settings to make the game enjoyable for all generations.
70010000120256.intro: Apidya is making a comeback in this authentic 24-bit pixel remake, built from the ground up, but utterly faithful to the original.
70010000120256.name: Apidya‘ Special

70010000070279.description:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.
Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” Immerse yourself in the Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you can infiltrate and elude your enemies to complete missions.

The game takes place five years after the Big Shell incident in METAL GEAR SOLID 2: Sons of Liberty, in a world where war has become a business.
To stop Liquid Ocelot's uprising, Solid Snake throws himself into his final battle.
The battle against Liquid and the Patriots draws to a close, and the mysteries woven throughout the series are now revealed!

【STORY】
THE TRANSFORMATION OF WAR INTO BUSINESS.
In an era where PMCs (private military companies) have risen to the top, war has become a business and the driving force behind the world economy. 

Controlling the top five PMCs from behind the scenes is Liquid Ocelot, who fanning the flames of war even further, plans an insurrection with the goal of creating a world where warriors can lead fulfilling lives—a goal shared by none other than Big Boss. 

Under the theme of “Sense” watch as the final battle of the man with Big Boss’s genes, Solid Snake, unfolds.

----------

70010000070284.description:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.
Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you avoid combat and complete missions while hiding.

The game take place 10 years after METAL GEAR SOLID 3: Snake Eater.
Amidst the swirling conspiracies behind the East-West Cold War, Snake confronts them while leading a private military force.
This is the story of how one soldier, “Snake”, becomes “Big Boss”.

【STORY】
THE ILLUSION OF PEACE FALTERS

In 1964, after saving the world from all-out nuclear war, Naked Snake, a true hero, receives the name Big Boss, but he disappears shortly after the naming ceremony.

Ten years later, Big Boss is running an independent military unit in Columbia, when he is visited by two individuals from Costa Rica, a country without a military.

In a post-Cuban Missile Crisis world, and in a Central America essential to maintaining the power balance between East and West, Costa Rica has been miraculously able to maintain peace.
However, a mysterious armed group has been seen acting suspiciously throughout the region.

They request Big Boss to investigate and eliminate the armed group.
Though he hesitates to accept the request because the tape they brought contained the voice of The Boss, who was supposed to be dead.

【System】
This title offers not only thrilling solo infiltration missions but also co-op with “SENYU” via online connections, and competitive multiplayer for up to six players.

The offshore facility Mother Base supports your missions.

It houses staff living quarters, development labs for mission weapons and gear, storage for captured large-scale weapons, and more. Expanding your staff allows Mother Base to grow and develop, incorporating simulation elements.

----------

70010000083759.description:
As purchase bonuses for the collection edition, it includes Metal Gear: Ghost Babel—the series first title for handheld consoles, released in 2000—and Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack Vol.2, featuring numerous iconic tracks that enhanced Snake's missions, ranging from BGM used in the games to vocal songs.

70010000087202.description:
Aggelos 2 is an explosive action-platformer where lightning-fast combat, precision platforming, and two opposing worlds collide. As an Aggelos, the highest order of angels, you are chosen by Balro to venture through the Kingdom of Lumen, domain of the supreme God of Light. But with Lumen under siege and the Gods facing imminent defeat at the hands of the Army of Darkness, you are forced to embrace a shadowy new form to survive the chaos of both light and dark realms.

While your angelic side favors a slower, disciplined approach, your demon form is highly agile, aggressive, and bristling with dark powers. Mastering the shift between both forms is key to survival, and only by balancing order and chaos can you hope to overcome formidable enemies, deadly obstacles, and challenging puzzles along your path.

- Parallel realms: Explore two massive, overlapping maps, each with their own unique characteristics, enemies to fight, secrets to discover, and challenges to overcome.
- Dual Combat System: Switch between Angel and Demon forms to change the world and your playstyle, from precise defenses to fast assaults, mastering timing, strategy, and reflexes.
- Emerge victorious: Take on hordes of enemies and conquer 13 massive bosses across both realms. Steel yourself for memorable encounters that build on the original game’s signature battles.
- Puzzles of Discovery: Solve challenges by mastering skills, memorising routes, manipulating mechanisms, avoiding traps, and interacting with the world to reveal secrets and new paths.
- Grow your power: Collect orbs to unlock devastating special attacks, boost your strength and increase your survivability, adding a tactical layer to your progression.
- Evolve to survive: Unlock new skills as you progress, from flight and wall grabs to dashes and powerful special attacks, offering up new ways to explore and reach previously inaccessible areas.
- Stunning 16-bit Artwork: Striking pixel art and detailed sprites designed to complement smooth, fast-paced 2D gameplay.
70010000087202.intro: Two forms. Two realms. One epic adventure awaits.
70010000087202.name: Aggelos 2

70010000091997.description:
A Seaplane, a Storm, and a Missing Uncle 

Take to the skies in your trusty seaplane on a heartfelt adventure across the tropical Limbo archipelago. After receiving a distress call from Uncle Lou, you arrive only to find the islands in disarray and Lou nowhere to be found. Collect resources, help rebuild a community, and unravel the mystery of your uncle’s disappearance. 

Collect, Craft, Restore 

Harness the vacuum power of the Swirler! — a glorious multi-tool — to collect everything from scrap and native plants to materials dropped by Limbo’s unique wildlife. Use your finds to repair buildings, craft goods, and help the communities thrive again. 

Claim your slice of paradise at Lou’s Lagoon. Build your dream beach hut, add your personal touch, and let the island rhythm take over.  

Meet the islanders of Limbo 

Discover the archipelago’s vibrant islands, each with their own spirited communities, hidden treasures, and unique problems to solve. Get a warm welcome from the Charneys in Tangle Bloom—the archipelago's liveliest town—then head to Gleam Reef to watch the Vooi move to the music of the tides. Lastly, visit Boulderia, home to the grumpy, sugar-crystal-mining Gorplins!

Key Features: 

- Explore the Limbo archipelago, home to vibrant communities and ancient secrets. 

- Pilot your very own seaplane, master ring challenges, and enjoy the freedom of open skies. 

- Upgrade your gadgets to expand your adventures. Scoop, build, glide and fish! 

- Personalize your seaplane with vibrant skins and custom configurations. 

- Full character customization. Make your avatar uniquely yours, from hairstyle to outfits and accessories. 

- Build your island base, decorate it, and make Lou’s Lagoon feel like home. 

- A mystery to unravel. Piece together clues, follow Lou’s trail, and uncover the truth behind his disappearance! 

Whether you’re hot on the trail to solving the mystery of Uncle Lou or just kicking back and enjoying island life, Lou’s Lagoon is your ticket to an exciting adventure.  

Ready for takeoff?
70010000091997.name: Lou's Lagoon

70010000124110.description: Horripilant is a chilling incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld. Combining idler, puzzle and autobattler elements, you'll fight, mine, and think your way through the depths of a forsaken dungeon. With each step you'll grow stronger, but beware; every boon has its burden.
70010000124110.name: Horripilant

70010000124430.description:
Discover a Gothic world in this 2D top-down action-adventure, blending fast-paced combat, exploration, and pixel art inspired by retro classics. Fight monstrous foes, unlock new abilities, and explore a non-linear map filled with hidden secrets and dangerous challenges.

COMBAT

Master precise combat, where every strike and dodge matters. Manage your stamina as you face off against grotesque enemies. You have a limited number of healing flasks so use them wisely. Upgrade your character's stats to remain effective in combat.

TOOLS

Discover powerful new tools hidden in the dungeons that enhance both combat and exploration. Unlock new abilities to defeat enemies more effectively and access hidden paths, uncovering deeper secrets within the world.

DUNGEONS

Uncover hidden dungeons throughout Tearscape's dark, interconnected world. Each dungeon holds unique challenges, powerful items, and deadly enemies, pushing your combat and exploration skills to the limit.

BOSS FIGHTS

Face off against challenging bosses: massive, grotesque creatures born from dark experiments. Each encounter demands precise timing, strategy, and mastery of your abilities to emerge victorious.

EXPLORATION

Explore the vast, interconnected map filled with branching paths, hidden shortcuts, and secret areas. The non-linear design encourages exploration, rewarding you with powerful items and new abilities.

NPCs

Encounter a diverse cast of NPCs, some offering guidance, others seeking your help, and a few with their own hidden agendas. Every interaction adds depth to the story.
70010000124430.name: Tearscape

70010000125567.description:
Discover and record 90+ plants, creatures, and fish at various locations around Shimmerbrook, and contribute your findings to the Archive.

Features
- Tame and raise 32 unique creatures
- Observe wild plants and grow them as crops based on different requirements
- Meet over 20 townsfolk, attend town festivals, go on hangout events
- Date and marry one of the 10 romanceable candidates
- Dig deep into the mines, fish, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery behind Shimmerbrook
- Cook, craft, build, and more!

Your life as a researcher starts today!
70010000125567.intro: Tame creatures, grow crops, and record your findings!
70010000125567.name: Research Story

70010000130237.description:
Get ready to enter a world of clever inventions, smart challenges, and brilliant solutions in Magnetail. In this charming puzzle adventure, you follow an ingenious inventor mouse who transforms workshops, laboratories, and storage rooms into playgrounds of experimentation and discovery.

Each level presents a new challenge where energy, magnetism, and logic work together. Push energy modules, watch them slide across the environment, and use magnets strategically to redirect trajectories, create barriers, and open unexpected paths. It may seem simple at first, but you will quickly discover that every move can completely change the outcome of the puzzle.

The key is thinking several steps ahead. Where will the module stop? Which magnet should be used first? Which route leaves the path clear for the next move? In Magnetail, every decision matters, and finding the perfect solution is as satisfying as powering up a complex machine for the very first time.

Explore 30 carefully crafted levels spread across busy workshops, experimental laboratories, and storage facilities filled with mechanical challenges. New situations constantly emerge, requiring observation, planning, and creativity to master the rules of magnetism and turn obstacles into opportunities.

With charming visuals, accessible controls, and puzzles that reward intelligence and experimentation, Magnetail delivers a relaxing, engaging, and highly rewarding experience. It is the kind of game that makes you stop, study the room for a moment, and then smile when the perfect solution finally clicks into place.

Align the modules, master the magnets, and prove that no invention is too complex for a brilliant mind.
70010000130237.intro: Think Like a Genius, Solve Like an Inventor
70010000130237.name: Magnetail

70010000133016.description:
One day, you’re just wandering down the track when you spot… a "neckless" giraffe?! Fair dinkum! Turns out, it's an incredibly rare new species whose neck grows over time. And guess what? It looks like the little mate has taken a real shine to you.

Right then, it's time to kick back and start your own relaxed, care-free life raising your very own special giraffe!

< How to live with your giraffe >
◆ Keep an eye on your giraffe's belly!
Your giraffe's hunger meter drops as time ticks by. To keep them happy and healthy, make sure to feed them some carrots so they don't miss out on their brekkie or tea!

◆ Harvest heaps of carrots in the mini-games!

Carrot Tower:
A balancing game where you stack carrots as high as you can. The higher the stack, the bigger the reward! But watch out—drop just one, and it's game over. Keep your focus and go for a high score!

Carrot Darts:
Take aim and chuck carrots at the target. Line up your shot and aim for the top score!

◆ Spend your earnings at the Shop!
Trade in the carrots you've collected for handy items. Grab "Mini-Game Tickets" or a "Name Tag" to give your giraffe a proper moniker. Stock up on helpful gear and become absolute best mates!
70010000133016.name: GIRAFFE RAISING GAME ~Reach for the sky~

70070000033352.description:
The extreme tension of infiltrating without being detected.
Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” Immerse yourself in the Metal Gear series, the pinnacle of “stealth action” where you can infiltrate and elude your enemies to complete missions.
This collection is the second installment of the definitive Metal Gear Master Collection.

Vol. 2 includes Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots and Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version).

Each game includes a Screenplay Book containing the text from the respective title, plus a Master Book offering detailed insights into the story and characters.

Also, as purchase bonuses for the collection edition, it includes METAL GEAR Ghost Babel—the series first title for handheld consoles, released in 2000—and Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack Vol.2, featuring numerous iconic tracks that enhanced Snake's missions, ranging from BGM used in the games to vocal songs.

[Game List]
Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots
Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version)
Metal Gear: Ghost Babel
*Versions for other regions of Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots can be downloaded separately from the store.
*Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version) supports online play for up to 6 players.

[Digital contents]
METAL GEAR SOLID 4 Database
Metal Gear Solid 4: Screenplay Book
Metal Gear Solid 4: Master Book
Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker Screenplay Book
Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker Master Book
Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack Vol.2

*The soundtrack can be enjoyed using the dedicated sound player included within the game.

・Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots Bonus: Gold Camouflage
・Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version) Bonus: Uniform: GOLD

70070000033352.intro: The second installment of the collection featuring “Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots” and “Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version)”
70070000033352.name: METAL GEAR SOLID: MASTER COLLECTION Vol.2

70010000095262.description:
Step into the halls of a hospital filled with mystery, desire, and raw emotion. Meet irresistible nurses, each with their own unique charm, and protect them—not just from outside threats, but from the wounds they carry within.

Through intimate questions and emotionally charged strategy gameplay, unlock suggestive images and endings as intense as they are unexpected.

Each nurse hides more than her uniform reveals. Can you truly understand her heart… and win it?


Features:

● Unique dual gameplay: Switch between deep, revealing questions that uncover her soul and defense mode, where you must shield her heart from emotional tension and past regrets.

● Suggestive scenes and unforgettable moments: Unlock intimate images and meaningful encounters—experiences that only unfold if you truly connect with her.

● Discover her most human side: Each response unveils pieces of her personality, hidden desires, and the secrets behind her professional smile.

● Multiple endings: What happens between you and her depends on your intuition, your choices… and how well you read between the lines.

● A secret, daring question: Reach the final moment and unlock a scene that will change everything.


Can you heal her heart… while yours races faster with every heartbeat?

Dare to live a story where romance, desire, and medicine entwine… and no one leaves untouched.
70010000095262.intro: Uncover the secrets of the hospital… while healing the heart of your ideal nurse.
70010000095262.name: Medical Lab Science: Anime Nurse Love in the Public Hospital

70010000107519.description:
A squad of mutant kids from the hood is humanity’s last hope in this colorful, humor-packed zombie apocalypse. Blast freaky zombies with ridiculous guns, spray wild graffiti across the city, and face a monstrous Zombie Boss at the end of every mission.

Each hero in the squad offers a unique playstyle: choose yours, dig the weirdest guns out of dumpsters, and enjoy the insane headshot animations.

THE SQUAD

Four young mutants, each with their own powers and playstyle, ready to blast some zombies! Pick your favorite (or the one with the collest look) and go wild!

FIND CRAZY GUNS

A Ketchup Blaster, a Gumball Shooter, a Shark-Head Shotgun, and even a Witch’s Broom, you’ll find all sorts of crazy guns to make zombies deeply regret their life (and death) choices.

KILL FREAK ZOMBIES

The writer definitely went off the rails here. Expect cute puppy zombies, tentacle-armed chonks, jacked-up cop zombies, and even an  Frankenstein with underwear. It doesn’t make much sense, but hey, it’s hilarious.

GRAFFITI THE WALLS

Painting graffiti in a zombie apocalypse isn’t easy. Every time you try to tag a wall, you might just summon an entire horde of the undead. Art has never been so dangerous (or colorful)!

DEFEAT THE ZOMBIE BOSS

This zombie clearly had a different breakfast. It’s stronger, meaner, and keeps coming back stronger each time. Beat the Boss Zombie and show it who’s the real monster here!
70010000107519.intro: Turn freaky zombies into a green goo explosion with a bunch of crazy guns and graffiti the walls while you try to save the city!
70010000107519.name: Ghetto Zombies: Graffiti Squad

70010000113636.description:
The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. Challenge a friend in the field or support Tsubasa on his Journey, the ball is yours.

• New and Improved Gameplay
Action on the field has been enhanced with powerful new super moves that intensify every action, from passing to blocking. The updated system adds more strategy, especially in goalkeeper versus shooter duels featuring spectacular super shots and blocks from the original series characters.

• A Soccer World That is Bigger Than Before!
Featuring 22 national teams, over 110 playable characters, and more than 150 cutscenes highlighting moves on the pitch! Previously unseen teams from the manga and original teams and characters clash in glorious, meticulous animation. The excitement of these once-in-a-lifetime moments has never been higher!

• Experience the New Storylines based on the World Youth Arc supervised by Yoichi Takahashi
Pick up where the first game left off and follow Tsubasa as he takes on formidable new rivals in the thrilling story based on the World Youth arc.
Discover expanded storylines overseen by the original creator, Yoichi Takahashi, and witness powerhouse nations clash as they chase international glory.
Step onto the pitch in the NEW STARS ROUTE, create your own custom player, join the Japanese national team, and fight alongside Tsubasa on the road to world victory.

• Powerful and Inspiring Music
Tadayoshi Makino (SpinSolfa), praised for his moving BGM tracks from the previous title, brings over 100 energized tracks to this iteration. Dare to compete with this exhilarating compilation of melodies perfectly suited to the high-octane action of Captain Tsubasa, the king of sports of anime, as Tsubasa and his teammates give their all on the pitch for the ultimate victory.

*This product is the Standard Edition. Other editions with additional content are available, so be careful of duplicate purchases.
70010000113636.name: CAPTAIN TSUBASA 2: WORLD FIGHTERS
ratingContent: Very mild themes, violence, in-game purchases and online interactivity

70010000119949.description:
This game is a drone simulation game that allows you to experience real drone flight based on footage shot by a real flying drone. 
There is no up, down, left or right direction control, only the control to increase or decrease the drone speed. 
You can also change the drone's flight mode from Normal, Sport, and Eco to any of the 3. 

Enjoy the beautiful scenery of Baekje Military Museum, Korea with "Real" footage! 
There are a total of 2 flight courses in 1 areas.
 high-definition footage faithfully reproduces the atmosphere of real nature, providing a strong sense of immersion in the game. 
Smooth and realistic video playback makes you feel like you are a real drone pilot. 
Large capacity! You can fly to locations that show the beautiful scenery of Korea! 
Two play modes are supported: course-specific flying mode and view mode automatic flight. There is also an achievement system. 
Visit Korea from home at any time! 
Enjoy the drone flight control experience and the beautiful natural scenery. MasCon for Nintendo Switch™ made by Zuiki of Japan is also supported.
70010000119949.name: Korean Drone Flying Tour Baekje Military Museum

70010000120315.description:
Play as Wigo, the Orc, whose wife has been kidnapped and taken up to the skies by a magic dress gifted by a mysterious Fairy.

As Wigo saw his wife going up to the skies, he went to the tallest building known on the continent: The Black Tower Enigma.

Inside the Black Tower Enigma, Wigo has to solve some riddles and challenges in order to climb up and find some clues to find his wife.

About levels

Each level is a small yet elaborate challenge that requires the player to use their intelligence and ability to decipher the riddles to advance through the Tower.

Also, Black Tower Enigma has an interesting background story, which is enriched inside the huge library scattered throughout each level of the tower.

Game features

- Elaborated puzzles, riddles, and hints along each level
- Interesting story discovered along each level
- Cool pixelated art-style
- Orchestral-designed music
- Simple and intuitive game play
70010000120315.intro: Puzzle-Solving Retro Adventure about an Orc inside a Mysterious Tower looking for his Wife.
70010000120315.name: Black Tower Enigma

70010000121572.description:
The Therian boys are untamed, magnetic, and not easy to read. They move on instinct, and the only way to get close is to prove you can keep up with them.

Take on Q&A rounds and hold your own in reflex minigame battles. Clear each challenge to unlock exclusive images in their gallery, one wild boy at a time.

Each guy has his own energy, his own edge, and his own way of warming up to someone he actually likes.

Which one is going to get under your skin first?


Features:

● MECHANICS THAT PUT YOU TO THE TEST: Q&A and reflex-based minigames trade off without warning. Answer smart, react fast, and keep moving.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Progress through each boy's arc to unlock exclusive gallery images saved just for you.

● DISTINCT PERSONALITIES: Every Therian boy reacts differently during gameplay, from encouraging to competitive to surprisingly tender when you least expect it.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: How things end depends on how far you go. Some connections take time. Some surprises come early. Keep playing to find out.

● HIDDEN SPECIAL MOMENT: Hit question 150 and something different happens. You'll want to get there.


These boys don't open up for everyone. But for the right person, who puts in the effort and stays in the game, something real is waiting at the other end. 

Start playing and find out if that someone is you.
70010000121572.intro:
These guys are wild by nature. 
Get close, earn their trust, and unlock what they don't show just anyone.
70010000121572.name: Therian Crush: Wild Animal Boys

70010000123221.description:
You awaken in a labyrinth of interconnected rooms with no memory of how you got there - and no obvious way out. Every corridor leads to another mystery, every door hides a new challenge, and every mistake brings you closer to failure.
Solve clever environmental puzzles, avoid deadly traps, and search for the path to freedom before time runs out. The maze is constantly testing your observation, logic, and decision-making, forcing you to think quickly under pressure.
With each room you conquer, the exit feels closer... yet the labyrinth always has another surprise waiting. Stay focused, keep moving, and make every second count - because the clock never stops ticking.
70010000123221.name: Inside the Cube

70010000123874.description:
WELCOME TO LEMURIA
A world inspired by Madagascar’s folklore. Once a paradise, it now suffers under the witch Raneny’s ruthless rule. Having grown tired of exploiting its people, she decides to host a huge concert with the island’s most famous band. You’re sent on a mission to fight back by rallying legendary musicians to your cause! 

THE (BOGUS) PROPHECY CHOSE YOU
Dash through diverse biomes across Lemuria, save and befriend funky locals to form your crew and jump over industrial platforming traps to become Lemuria’s number one band and finally face Raneny!

DANCING THROUGH JOYFUL CHAOS
Defeat Raneny’s minions in fast-paced combat, using hair-based powers and improvised weapons (slippers included) to fight epic and groovy boss battles and free the island! 

HOP ON A FUN MUSICAL ROAD TRIP 
Assemble a band with eccentric lemur artists, manage your tour bus through mini-games and build your band’s popularity among locals to perform on bigger stages.
70010000123874.intro: Kalanoro is an action-adventure mixing platforming, combat and light management!
70010000123874.name: Kalanoro

70010000125714.intro: Tour beautiful places and dance the Sardana with the hidden cats of Barcelona!
70010000125714.name: Hidden Cats in Barcelona

70010000127039.description:
Drifting isn’t about speed — it’s about control, flow, and style.

Step into a relaxed yet skill-based drifting experience where every corner is an opportunity to build momentum and score. Set across snowy tracks with a clean low-poly aesthetic, the game focuses on smooth driving, precision, and maintaining long, controlled drifts.

Chain together turns, control your angle, and keep your speed to build higher scores. The closer you get to obstacles and the longer you hold your drift, the more rewarding each run becomes. Every mistake breaks your flow, so staying focused is key.

Use handbrake turns to initiate drifts and nitro boosts to maintain speed through long curves. As you progress, unlock new cars with different handling styles and explore new locations designed to challenge your control and creativity behind the wheel.

Key Features:
	•	Drift System: Earn points through angle, speed, and control
	•	Smooth Arcade Handling: Easy to learn, challenging to master
	•	Nitro & Handbrake Mechanics: Extend drifts and maintain flow
	•	Multiple Cars: Unlock vehicles with unique driving feel
	•	Snowy Environments: Clean low-poly tracks with atmospheric design
	•	Progression System: Earn rewards, unlock locations, and improve performance
Art of Drift – Cozy Drift Simulator delivers a satisfying drifting experience where precision, timing, and style define every ride.
70010000127039.intro: Feel the drift, not the rush
70010000127039.name: Art of Drift – Cozy Drift Simulator

70010000127045.description:
Players take on the role of an alien monster, devouring and fighting against human armed forces with various transformations, and annihilating the world. By continuously devouring humans to obtain energy, numerous weapons and abilities can be added to combat human armed forces and eliminate the world. When encountering different extraterrestrial crystals, one can acquire different superpowers. And it can have different transformations in different situations, experiencing super destructive power.

This is a Roguelike game where players operate an alien monster to devour humans, obtaining dozens of weapons, shields, and more through the energy gained Buff、 Follow the ball, fire different energy bullets, and merge these bullets for firing. Different follower balls can also attack in different ways.

In the game, there are randomly encountered alien crystals that can acquire different superpowers, providing abilities such as freezing, fire breathing, and protective shields, making the game process more interesting.

In the game, you can also have different transformations and experience super destructive power. If it can transform into a super ape with invincible power, it can directly destroy houses and police cars in the city.

Players can choose different characters to play the game, and multiple maps are set up to confront humans in different environments. And designed a 6-level difficulty level, constantly challenging one's own abilities. The game features nearly a hundred achievements, requiring constant achievement in intense battles.

Players can continuously enhance their abilities, including health, health recovery, damage, attack speed, critical hit rate, etc., through the game's outsider cultivation function.
70010000127045.intro:
Devour and destroy the world.
Fighting against armed forces with various transformations.
Obtain energy, numerous weapons and abilities.
70010000127045.name: Monst

70010000127383.description:
Golftacular! is mini-golf... barely. Mix party game chaos and dumb fun with precision and strategy.

Up to 4 players take turns as Tortillo, Chuck, Fin, Poop, Papa, Mama, Claude, and Frend, each one aiming for the hole while unleashing chaos on anyone foolish enough to stand in the way.

Enjoy endless replayability with dozens of handcrafted courses and thousands of possible item combos. Items shake up everything: turn the course into your personal parkour playground or an obstacle-filled nightmare for your opponents. Call in airstrikes, play rock-paper-scissors, give your ball wings, place portals... and that’s just the tip of the iceberg.


FEATURES

- Items, Items, Items - Use items for game breaking abilities and combos
- Ear Candy Radio - Bumping original sound track
- Express yourself - Pick from a cast of whackos... which one are you?
- Play it your way - Play with keyboard & mouse or controllers
- Not enough controllers? No Problem! - Pass and play mode lets you share
- No friends? No problem! - Tackle challenging courses alone in single player puzzles
70010000127383.intro: Mini-golf turned upside down! Abuse wild items on a variety of challenging golf tours. Shoot, fly, explode, and whatever else you can to get in the hole! It’s golf... barely.
70010000127383.name: Golftacular!

70010000130462.description:
Move through 3D space to find hints, solve mysteries and escape from the room.
Anyone can play to the end because you can see hints and answers.
70010000130462.name: Escape game R00M16

70010000131735.description:
Welcome to Fernkeep, a cosy exploration game set within the walls of a peaceful medieval stronghold. Wander through towering castles, bustling courtyards, narrow cobblestone streets, hidden gardens, and ancient towers as you search for every unique location throughout the town.

Features:
>Explore a handcrafted medieval castle town.
>Discover every hidden location and secret area.
>Wander through castles, courtyards, markets, gardens, and towers.
>Enjoy a relaxing, stress-free exploration experience.
>Immerse yourself in a peaceful medieval atmosphere.
>No combat, no timers, and no pressure—just exploration.
70010000131735.intro: Discover the quiet charm of a medieval castle town.
70010000131735.name: Fernkeep

70010000131882.description:
Project City is a top-down open-city action game inspired by the chaotic feel of classic arcade crime sandboxes. Hit the streets in a drivable city full of traffic, pedestrians, shops, police, gangs, odd jobs, and escalating trouble.

Earn cash by running taxi fares, package drops, food deliveries, and risky crew work, or push your luck with ATM hacks and weapon shop visits. Slide into drift challenges, dodge police heat, avoid spike strips and roadblocks, and keep moving when the city turns against you. Every run is about choosing how far to hustle, how much chaos to cause, and whether you can survive long enough to cash out.
With fast driving, on-foot exploration, wanted levels, city events, weapons, interiors, leaderboards, and a sharp street-comedy tone, Project City is a compact urban mayhem sandbox built around simple controls and constant trouble.
70010000131882.intro: Drive, drift, hustle, and survive a city that reacts to every bad decision.
70010000131882.name: Project City

70050000070126.description:
This DLC unlocks a brand new world for hexceed: Capricornus! 
Puzzle your way through 123 brand-new levels!
70050000070126.intro: Unlocks a new world for hexceed: Capricornus brings 123 new puzzles and includes all mechanics from the previous DLC.
70050000070126.name: Capricornus

70050000070598.description:
State of Panic
Resurrection Core Edition continues to expand with new characters and new levels, delivered as part of the Season Pass. Each content drop introduces a new level alongside a new character to unlock and master, bringing fresh playstyles, abilities, and challenges to the game. As the season progresses, players will explore new environments, face new combat encounters, and expand their roster with powerful new heroes, keeping the experience evolving for returning players. 
*subject to change
70050000070598.name: State of Panic

Action on the field has been enhanced with powerful new super moves that intensify every action, from passing to blocking. The updated system adds more strategy, especially in goalkeeper versus shooter duels featuring spectacular super shots and blocks from the original series characters.

Pick up where the first game left off and follow Tsubasa as he takes on formidable new rivals in the thrilling story based on the World Youth arc.

Step onto the pitch in the NEW STARS ROUTE, create your own custom player, join the Japanese national team, and fight alongside Tsubasa on the road to world victory.
